source.purpose: Committed snapshot for CI and repo-local VET-1560 artifact generation when the workspace-local AutoScientists config is unavailable.

sources.summary: Reference implementation for a decoder-only Transformer training pipeline: dataset download, preprocessing, tokenization, configurable architecture, training loop, checkpoint save, and generation script.
observedImplementationDetails: config.py centralizes vocabulary size, context length, embedding size, head count, block count, batch size, training steps, eval cadence, learning-rate schedule, output path, and device
data_loader.py reads tokenized HDF5 data, builds contiguous next-token prediction windows, shuffles examples, and yields input/target batches
train_transformer.py builds the model from config, trains with AdamW, evaluates train/dev loss on a cadence, decays learning rate once, and saves model state plus optimizer/loss metadata
transformer.py combines token embeddings, positional embeddings, stacked Transformer blocks, final layer norm, language-model head, cross-entropy loss, and multinomial token generation
transferableTechniques: keep dataset download, preprocessing, training, evaluation, checkpoint, and generation as separate reviewable stages
start with small model or adapter experiments before any billion-parameter or production NIM change
pin tokenizer, context length, embedding size, head count, block count, batch size, data manifest, and checkpoint identity in config
validate on held-out clinical and owner-language tasks before considering runtime promotion
treat all model-learning work as weight-update candidates until artifacts, eval manifests, rollback, and explicit approval exist
nonTransferableClaims: does not prove a PawVital model is clinically safe
does not directly improve deployed NVIDIA NIM models
does not replace deterministic clinical logic, route tests, owner approval, or production-like verification
sources.pawvitalUse: Use as a training-harness pattern for PawVital offline model experiments, dataset-factory improvements, and NIM routing evaluation tickets. Do not mutate runtime model flags from this source alone.

sources.summary: Local-first sidecar pattern for observing agent instruction behavior, generating evidence-backed proposal artifacts, and governing any instruction patch through deterministic policy, evals, reviewer approval, rollback, and audit records.
observedImplementationDetails: README describes Tugboat as a local-first sidecar for agent instruction observability and governed optimization over CODEX.md, AGENTS.md, SKILL.md, runbooks, eval definitions, and local policy files
SPEC separates the main coding agent from the sidecar supervisor and keeps llmff bounded to typed pipeline execution, traces, events, checkpoints, and output handling
SPEC requires proposal-only default posture, evidence-backed patches, deterministic policy gates, held-out evals, VCS-backed application, rollback, and append-only audit records
quickstart initializes local proposal-only policy, indexes the instruction corpus, runs optimize/audit/propose/eval/report over trace bundles, and keeps provider-backed smoke checks opt-in
transferableTechniques: treat AGENTS.md, RULES.md, AutoScientists runbooks, skills, eval definitions, and local.config.json as production instruction artifacts with owners, hashes, precedence, and protected sections
convert repeated PawVital ticket failures or user corrections into redacted trace bundles before proposing instruction changes
use a proposal-only audit/propose/eval loop for instruction drift, stale commands, missing handoff gates, and conflicting rules
require deterministic policy gates, held-out regression cases, reviewer approval, rollback notes, and audit-ledger entries before applying instruction patches
keep auto-apply disabled for protected headings, model/provider routing, deployment, secrets, approval policy, clinical logic, and sidecar authority
nonTransferableClaims: does not improve PawVital NIM or AI model weights
does not authorize automatic edits to AGENTS.md, RULES.md, skills, or local.config.json
does not replace AutoScientists, SIA, thermo-review, clinical review, project-manager gates, or production verification
does not justify provider-backed llmff runs, live network access, or auto-apply without explicit owner approval
sources.pawvitalUse: Use as a governance pattern for future PawVital instruction observability and proposal-only instruction patch workflows. Keep it separate from model/NIM promotion and product intelligence runtime work.

modelTechniqueIntake.nextAgentInstruction: Before changing NIM, narrow-pack, AI model routing, dataset preprocessing, training, adapters, owner-visible model intelligence, or PawVital instruction governance, read modelTechniqueIntake, choose the matching VET-1561..VET-1565 ticket path, define the holdout or governance verifier, and keep the work review-only until the weight-update, proposal-only governance, and owner-approval gates pass.
